policy: Local artifact SHA-256 is authoritative. No substitution. Smoke tests are loading/shape only on a seeded synthetic tensor; no train/dev/test performance or comparative embeddings computed.

approved_pin.use: backbone features only (CLS embedding after final norm), no head

dinov2_vits14.upstream_checkpoint_url: https://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/dinov2/dinov2_vits14/dinov2_vits14_pretrain.pth (constructed by the official code: dinov2/hub/backbones.py, _DINOV2_BASE_URL + model_base_name/model_full_name_pretrain.pth, weights=LVD142M)
dinov2_vits14.preprocessing: 224x224 input (frozen letterbox crop), ImageNet mean/std (0.485,0.456,0.406)/(0.229,0.224,0.225); patch 14 gives 16x16 tokens
dinov2_vits14.license_provenance: Official DINOv2 repository README states code and model weights are Apache License 2.0 (repo commit 7764ea0f...). File supplied by the investigator, not downloaded by Claude; no upstream hash exists in the official release to compare against, so the local SHA-256 is the authoritative record and is attested only by the investigator's statement that the file is the official release.
dinov2_vits14.reachability_2026-10-17: dl.fbaipublicfiles.com: proxy CONNECT 403 (not on the allowlist); huggingface.co no response; code repo reachable via the git proxy

approved_pin.checkpoint: person-ReID-trained, training source MSMT17, combineall=True, cross-domain checkpoint (model zoo section 'MSMT17 (combineall=True) -> Market1501 & DukeMTMC-reID', row osnet_x1_0, softmax, (256,128), random_flip + color_jitter, euclidean)
approved_pin.rationale_recorded_prospectively: The intended use is person re-ID on professional-wrestling broadcast footage, a domain unseen by standard ReID datasets; the MSMT17 combineall cross-domain checkpoint is selected prospectively for its domain-generalisation training/evaluation role rather than a same-domain Market1501, DukeMTMC-reID or ordinary MSMT17 checkpoint. Chosen before any V0.6 comparative result exists; not to be revisited based on performance.
forbidden: any checkpoint selected after examining V0.6 performance

osnet_x1_0_reid.pretraining_dataset: MSMT17, combineall=True (per the official model zoo table)

loading_code.entry: torchreid/models/osnet.py osnet_x1_0(num_classes=<from checkpoint classifier>, pretrained=False) loaded by file path, strict load_state_dict

osnet_x1_0_reid.preprocessing: 256x128 (H x W) input per the model zoo, ImageNet mean/std; the frozen 224 letterbox crop must be resized to 256x128 only if the reviewer approves it as part of the pinned record (a size/aspect change is part of the pin)
osnet_x1_0_reid.license_provenance: deep-person-reid code: MIT (repo LICENSE at commit f8cd150f...). Checkpoint supplied by the investigator, Drive id 1IosIFlLiulGIjwW3H8uMRmx3MzPwf86x (not downloaded by Claude). Consistency evidence only, not proof of upstream identity: the filename states msmt17 / combineall / 256x128 / softmax_labelsmooth / flip_jitter, and the classifier has 4101 outputs, which is not the 1000-class ImageNet initialisation and matches the identity count expected for MSMT17 train+test combined (1041 + 3060). The official zoo publishes no hash, so the local SHA-256 is authoritative.
osnet_x1_0_reid.reachability_2026-10-17: drive.google.com: no response; code repo reachable via the git proxy

official_checkpoint_identifier.model_zoo_doc: docs/MODEL_ZOO.md line 73 at deep-person-reid commit f8cd150fdf77e8d9e1ed143b7f308c2c609ded50

osnet_x1_0_reid.classifier_dim_note: The smoke test records classifier_out_dim as an informational diagnostic (a combineall MSMT17 checkpoint would be expected to have a large identity classifier; the value is recorded, not assumed). The hard checks are: not 1000 (ImageNet init), strict load, 512-d deterministic output.

smoke_tool.self_test: run on randomly initialised models in a temp directory with synthetic tensors: dinov2 ViT-S/14 passes, dinov2 register variant is rejected, osnet re-ID-like (classifier 751) passes, ImageNet-like (classifier 1000) is rejected. This validates the tool only; it says nothing about any real artifact.
